intro.title: Experience Private & Luxury Travel
intro.p1: HUYEN TRANG TOUR is the premier private car service in Hue and Central Vietnam. We operate 4 to 7-seater VinFast Limo Green electric vehicles – providing smooth, whisper-quiet rides and spacious comfort on every route.
intro.p2: Whether you are discovering Hue's royal tombs, crossing Hai Van Pass to Da Nang, walking through Hoi An Ancient Town, or exploring Phong Nha caves, our team is committed to thoughtful, punctual, and reliable service.
intro.h1: Modern VinFast Limo Green 4 to 7-seater electric vehicle, eco-friendly & smooth
intro.h2: Private transfers on demand, no shared passengers, flexible schedule
intro.h3: Serving Hue, Da Nang, Hoi An, Phong Nha, Quang Tri routes
intro.h4: 24/7 customer support via Hotline, Zalo, WhatsApp, Messenger

about.title: HUYEN TRANG TOUR
about.slogan: "Your Journey, Our Passion – With You on Every Mile."
about.storyTitle: Explore Central Vietnam Your Own Way
about.story1: Founded in Hue, the historic imperial capital of Vietnam, HUYEN TRANG TOUR was created to offer international and domestic travelers private, civilized, and deeply comfortable journeys.
about.story2: We believe travel is not merely getting from A to B, but a treasured part of your vacation memories. That is why we invest in top-tier vehicles, punctuality, and attentive hospitality.
about.story3: Whether you are touring Hue's royal tombs, traveling along Hai Van Pass to Da Nang, soaking in Hoi An's lantern-lit streets, or visiting Phong Nha caves, we are dedicated to serving you.
about.evTitle: 4 to 7-Seater VinFast Limo Green Electric Car
about.evDesc: Choosing green electric vehicles reflects our dedication to sustainable tourism. The VinFast Limo Green provides smooth, silent journeys without engine noise or exhaust fumes, minimizing motion sickness.
about.valuesSubtitle: Every trip with HUYEN TRANG TOUR is built upon mutual respect, safety, and unwavering professionalism.
about.v1Desc: Modern vehicles inspected rigorously before every journey, guaranteeing complete passenger safety.
about.v2Desc: Always punctual, careful luggage handling, polite conduct, respecting your private space.
about.v3Desc: Luxury leather seats, ice-cold air conditioning, complimentary mineral water, quiet cabin free of exhaust fumes.
about.v4Desc: Clear all-inclusive quotes per route with zero hidden surcharges for your peace of mind.
